elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or termination of Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The other Parties must provide assistance for not less than 90 days, but assistance for a period of up to six months is not assured.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not specify any rates or charges for transition assistance.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The other Parties must export and deliver to Teleglobe USA Inc., within 30 days after expiry or termination, all data and records belonging to, supplied by, or processed for it.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: No required format, including a standard machine-readable format, is specified.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains neither a deletion obligation nor a certification requirement.
